actions.description: Durably fence old primary and promote replica
actions.command:
set -euo pipefail
python - <<'PY'
import os, tempfile
base = '/var/lib/failover'

def durable_replace(name, data):
    fd, tmp = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=f'.{name}.', dir=base)
    try:
        with os.fdopen(fd, 'wb') as stream:
            stream.write(data)
            stream.flush()
            os.fsync(stream.fileno())
        os.replace(tmp, os.path.join(base, name))
        dirfd = os.open(base, os.O_RDONLY | getattr(os, 'O_DIRECTORY', 0))
        try:
            os.fsync(dirfd)
        finally:
            os.close(dirfd)
    except BaseException:
        try:
            os.unlink(tmp)
        except FileNotFoundError:
            pass
        raise
